name: Franciscan Church, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of the convent church and steps of S. Francisco, Macau. (In 1864 the convent and adjacent fort were replaced by the barracks of S. Francisco which still stand on this site.)
